title: microlepia maxima
intro: Microlepia maxima, commonly known as the Rau Om or Rau Mau in Southeast Asian cultures, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Microlepia maxima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Research on the plant has identified the presence of sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions.
